units.title: SG-8.2.1 Block blank contribution submit with an inline message
Act: Show 'Enter an idea first' for blank submit in ContributionSheet
Act: Clear the blank-text message on typing and valid submit
Verify: Blank and whitespace-only submit shows the inline message unit tests

tests.name: contributionBlank.test.tsx > empty text shows "Enter an idea first" and does not submit
tests.title: empty text shows "Enter an idea first" and does not submit
tests.scenario: Given the sheet is open with an empty textarea, When Send is clicked, Then the alert reads 'Enter an idea first' and submitContribution is called 0 times

tests.name: contributionBlank.test.tsx > whitespace-only text shows "Enter an idea first" and does not submit
tests.title: whitespace-only text shows "Enter an idea first" and does not submit
tests.scenario: Given the textarea holds '   \n  ', When Send is clicked, Then the alert reads 'Enter an idea first' and submitContribution is not called

tests.name: contributionBlank.test.tsx > textarea is marked invalid and described by the alert after a blank submit
tests.title: textarea is marked invalid and described by the alert after a blank submit
tests.scenario: Given a blank Send, Then the textarea has aria-invalid='true' and aria-describedby equal to the alert id

tests.name: contributionBlank.test.tsx (mock setup and render)
tests.title: Blank submit sheet loads with client mocks in place
tests.scenario: Given vi.mock of ../src/api/client and a rendered ContributionSheet, the file loads and tests run
tests.detail: File loads; full file 5 passed on final run (one earlier run had 1 timing-flaky failure in a test outside this unit's steps, not reproduced)

units.title: Verify: Blank message clears on typing and valid submit unit tests

tests.name: typing clears the blank message
tests.title: typing clears the blank message and the invalid state
tests.scenario: Given a blank submit shows the alert, when the user types 'a' into the textarea, then no alert is shown, aria-invalid is not 'true', and submitContribution is not called
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionBlank.test.tsx -t "typing clears" --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: valid idea after a blank attempt is sent trimmed
tests.name: valid idea after a blank attempt is sent trimmed
tests.title: a valid idea after a blank attempt is sent trimmed and the blank message is gone
tests.scenario: Given a blank submit, when the user types '  hello  ' and clicks Send, then submitContribution (mocked to resolve) is called once with 'hello' and no 'Enter an idea first' text remains
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/contributionBlank.test.tsx -t "sent trimmed" --testTimeout=10000
